entities.name: PMID:25425494
observations: CONAART early-arthritis cohort study in Argentina; 848 patients (483 RA, 365 undifferentiated arthritis), followed across 13 rheumatology departments.
Unemployment was similar in RA (21.0%) and undifferentiated arthritis (18.6%; nonsignificant); disease activity was the main multivariable correlate of unemployment in both groups.
Work disability was assessed primarily as unemployment; abstract does not provide adjusted effect estimates or enough detail to establish the adjusted coefficient for diagnosis.

observations.name: Arthritis work disability
observations: In the Argentine early-arthritis cohort, unemployment prevalence was comparable in rheumatoid arthritis and undifferentiated arthritis (21.0% vs 18.6%, nonsignificant); disease activity was the main multivariable correlate, supporting association with active arthritis rather than diagnostic label, with unemployment used as the work-disability proxy.
